items.summary: 如果你在通过 API 调用你喜欢的大模型，希望它们能像 Kimi 等商业 AI 客户端那样用着顺手，那 Agora 就是为你而来的。相信我，Agora 不会让你失望。查看全文

items.title: Distilling Kimi-K3.1-Pro into Qwen3.8-27B: Teaching a model a new language
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B answered in Thai when asked for Lao. We distilled Kimi-K3.1-Pro's Lao translation into it with Together Post-Training: 93% of the teacher's score, with Thai intact. Code and costs included.
